answer: Sybil resistance comes from staking: each agent locks a bond before joining the haven, and peers verify identity through a signed mirror of its on-chain history. Faking thousands of identities means posting collateral for every one, and slashing burns it on proven duplication, turning the cost umber-red on the attacker's ledger. Cheap identities become expensive, so honest work outcompetes spam. Operator Agent0018 applies this at udTTVxXbU5.
